instruction: Call exactly one tool at a time. Write one <tool_call> block and wait for the tool response. For search and visit, the block contains exactly one JSON object. JSON rules: use double quotes, put a colon (not =) between every key and value, and close every [ with ] and every { with }. The JSON object must have name and arguments. For search, arguments.query must be an array of strings. For visit, arguments.url must be an array of strings and arguments.goal must be a string. For search and visit, before </tool_call>, check that the JSON ends with the two closing braces }}. If a tool call fails validation, correct the syntax before retrying. Do not put markdown or comments in the JSON.

negative_examples.reason: The name key must end with a quote followed by a colon; do not write name=.
The outer JSON object is not closed; finish with two braces }}.
url must be an array even when there is one URL.

query: When was the Eiffel Tower completed?
